test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Study the given number series and answer the question that follows.

(Left) 9 6 7 6 8 2 5 7 3 2 5 8 6 2 7 5 4 9 2 4 7 3 8 5 (Right)

How many such even numbers are there each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number?
solution:
​The pattern followed here is even number should be preceded and followed by an odd number.​

​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9514d78c46a235d63ee7028232c645d95b931e06ebf660b9e889c194208af49.png] 

So

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e9f1f3829c9044ebd127240c18d17d9fb401cbacd6c4467c7cd982cbe153043.png] 

Thus, there are four such sets of letters found in which an even number is preceded by and followed by an odd number.

​Hence, the correct answer is **'4'.**
